description: Read one section of a book as Markdown, with its subsections, its code examples (each with the versions it was run on and whether it passes) and its citation block. A chapter's ID gives the chapter's opening. A long section comes in pages: pass the `next_cursor` you were given as `cursor` for the next one. An earlier ID of a section still works, and the answer says what it's called now. Give `language`, such as "ja" or "Japanese", for Rolling Edition's own translation, where the book has one: the section in that language, its code examples as they are, the facts of the translation, and the sections still in English (`untranslated`). The citation stays the English edition's.
name: get_section
title: Read a section
